get_current_scope_id: get the current scope ID from the PyTorch Dynamo SubgraphTracer context
enter_new_scope: enter a new scope context that increments and decrements the scope ID on entry and exit
test_current_scope_id: test the current_scope_id function returns the expected integer value
test_enter_new_scope: test the enter_new_scope context manager increments and decrements the scope ID correctly
test_nested_scopes: test nested enter_new_scope calls properly increment and decrement the scope ID
